summary: Explored both the gizmo and gizmo-registry repos to map out a protocol migration from v25 to v26 that makes project status opaque per-extension, then began implementing: updated the protocol package tests and exports, replaced CompositeProjectService with ProjectServiceRegistry (with an ordered entries accessor for v25 compat), and drafted per-extension watch coordinator, v25-compat project request handler, and websocket connection plumbing in agent-server.
decisions: ProjectStatus type is now `unknown` (opaque) — extensions own payload shape, validation, and errors; core consumers validate whichever extension's data they render.
Replaced CompositeProjectService with ProjectServiceRegistry (Map-based, per-extension lookup by extensionId) with an ordered `entries` accessor reserved for v25 compatibility routing.

v25 client compatibility is isolated: requests without extensionId resolve to the first registered service in order; watch falls through entries until one succeeds, preserving original 'first extension wins' semantics.

Per-extension watches are tracked by extensionId; on path switch the coordinator stops only the extension-host watch and lets individual service watches be replaced when the app re-watches each status extension.
websocket option `noProjectServices` became an empty ProjectServiceRegistry instance; project.status.changed events now carry an opaque `extensions` map keyed by extensionId.
errors: Initial draft of project-watch-coordinator.ts contained a double watchStatus call and an unnecessary stopServiceWatches map; it was rewritten cleanly after the flaw was recognized.
